scripts.check: node -e "const fs=require(\"fs\"),cp=require(\"child_process\"); const files=[]; function walk(x){for(const f of fs.readdirSync(x)){const p=x+\"/\"+f; if(fs.statSync(p).isDirectory())walk(p); else if(p.endsWith(\".js\"))files.push(p)}} walk(\"src\"); for(const f of files) cp.execFileSync(process.execPath,[\"--check\",f]); console.log(\"Syntax check passed: \"+files.length+\" files\")"
